name: HUSHAN Autoparts, Inc.
summary: Hushan Autoparts Inc. manufactures and sells aftermarket door handles for cars in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers exterior and interior door, tailgate, and window regulator handles; rear view and tailgate handle cameras; parking sensors and parking sensor bezels; window regulators; clips/fasteners; door components, such as locks, hings, door checks, and keys; fastener, which includes linkage bushing, metal screw / nut, push rivet, screw grommet, scrivet, trim clip, weatherstrip clip, fastener tray, brush clip, connector, blind rivet-p, blind rivet-m; and heavy duty products. It also offers bumper bracket, license lamp, lock cylinder, pedal pad, pillar trim moulding, tailgate rebuild kit, repair kit, rod, striker, sun visor, tailgate moulding, 3rd brake light, and wheel center cap products. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
